quintBinding.name: Aster Quint Bridge
quintBinding.driverGuidanceMarkdown:
- Implement an Aster replay driver for each executable QNT/MBT slice.
- Map QNT action names to target implementation calls using the Aster bridge dispatcher.
- Expose comparable implementation state through the Aster bridge state projection.
quintBinding.reproductionMarkdown: Use `ASTER_QNT_SEED=<seed>` to reproduce a failing Aster Quint Bridge run and `ASTER_QNT_VERBOSE=1` when trace details are needed.
